title: Propowerup Faces
description: Makes faces look like Propowerups. Propowerup1234 is my channel.
body: This resource pack makes entities, blocks, and items with faces become the face of Propowerup. All the stuff that were changed were: dispensers, droppers, observers, zombie head, player head, skeleton head, wither skeleton head, zombie, skeleton, wither skeleton, totem, and the sun.
